senses.en: a small shiny piece of metal or plastic used to decorate clothing

example.en: Her dress was covered with gold spangles.
example.zh: 她的连衣裙缀满了金色亮片。

senses.en: to decorate with shiny pieces; to glitter

example.en: The costume was spangled with tiny mirrors.
example.zh: 戏服上缀满了小镜子片。

senses.en: a person who plays football, especially soccer, professionally

example.en: The young footballer scored a goal in his first match.
example.zh: 这位年轻的足球运动员在首场比赛中就进了一球。

senses.en: coming after the fifty-ninth in order; 60th

example.en: The company celebrated its sixtieth anniversary last year.
example.zh: 公司去年庆祝了成立六十周年。

senses.en: one of sixty equal parts of something

example.en: The estate was divided into sixtieths among the heirs.
example.zh: 遗产被分成六十分之一份由继承人分配。

senses.en: lazy; unwilling to work or make an effort

example.en: He was fired for being slothful at his job.
example.zh: 他因工作懒散而被解雇了。

senses.en: an older term for a sudden stroke, often with loss of consciousness

example.en: In older medical texts, sudden stroke was often called apoplexy.
example.zh: 在旧医学文献中，突发中风常被称为 apoplexy。

senses.en: a fit of extreme rage (figurative)

example.en: The scandal sent the committee into apoplexy.
example.zh: 这桩丑闻让委员会勃然大怒。

senses.en: a permanent executive committee, especially in socialist countries, that acts for a larger legislative body

example.en: The presidium met to discuss the new policy.
example.zh: 主席团开会讨论新政策。

senses.en: a person whose business is making, selling, or repairing fur garments

example.en: The furrier crafted a fine coat from mink.
example.zh: 那位毛皮匠用貂皮做了一件精美的大衣。

senses.en: indicating a starting point in place or time

example.en: She comes from China.
example.zh: 她来自中国。

senses.en: indicating cause or source

example.en: She was exhausted from the long journey.
example.zh: 长途旅行让她筋疲力尽。

senses.en: a small flap or tag used for holding, marking, or opening something

example.en: He pulled the tab to open the soda can.
example.zh: 他拉开拉环打开了汽水罐。

senses.en: a key or marker on a computer keyboard or screen used to move to the next position or open a new page section

example.en: Press the Tab key to move to the next field.
example.zh: 按制表键跳到下一个输入框。

senses.en: informal word for a bill, especially in a restaurant or bar

example.en: It's my turn to pick up the tab for dinner.
example.zh: 这顿饭轮到我买单了。

senses.en: a close watch on someone or something, used in keep tabs on
senses.zh: 监视；密切关注（用于 keep tabs on）

example.en: The team keeps tabs on the project's progress.
example.zh: 团队密切跟踪项目进展。

senses.en: causing horror or shock; very bad

example.en: The news showed horrific scenes of the accident.
example.zh: 新闻报道了事故中骇人的画面。

senses.en: made to be thrown away after use

example.en: We used disposable cups at the party.
example.zh: 我们在派对上用了一次性杯子。

senses.en: available to be spent or used freely

example.en: After rent, he has little disposable income left.
example.zh: 付完房租后，他几乎没有可自由支配的收入了。

senses.en: an item designed to be thrown away after use

example.en: The clinic buys its disposables in bulk.
example.zh: 诊所批量采购一次性用品。

senses.en: (archaic) you, as the object of a verb or preposition

example.en: I give thee my thanks.
example.zh: 我向你致谢。

senses.en: a substance that stops or counteracts the effects of a poison

example.en: Doctors administered an antidote to counteract the snake venom.
example.zh: 医生使用了解毒剂来对抗蛇毒。

senses.en: something that removes the bad effects of a situation or feeling
senses.zh: 消除不良影响的东西；解药

example.en: Laughter is often called a good antidote to stress.
example.zh: 笑常被称为缓解压力的良方。

senses.en: to give a document, plan, or application to someone for review or consideration

example.en: Please submit your application before Friday.
example.zh: 请在周五之前提交申请。

senses.en: to yield to someone else's authority or power

example.en: The soldiers refused to submit to the enemy.
example.zh: 士兵们拒绝向敌人屈服。

senses.en: Needing someone or something for support, help, or supply.

example.en: Young children are dependent on their parents for food and shelter.
example.zh: 幼儿依赖父母提供食物和住所。

senses.en: Decided or affected by something else.

example.en: The project's success is dependent on good communication.
example.zh: 项目的成功取决于良好的沟通。

senses.en: A person who relies on another for support, especially financial support.

example.en: He lists his mother as a dependent on his tax form.
example.zh: 他在税务表格上把母亲列为受抚养人。

senses.en: a written order from a doctor for medicine or treatment

example.en: The doctor wrote me a prescription for antibiotics.
example.zh: 医生给我开了一张抗生素处方。

senses.en: a medicine that a doctor has ordered for a patient

example.en: She collected her prescription from the pharmacy.
example.zh: 她从药房取了处方药。

senses.en: a recommended plan for solving a problem
senses.zh: 解决问题的建议方案；对策

example.en: The committee proposed a prescription for improving public health.
example.zh: 委员会提出了改善公共卫生的对策。

senses.en: a matter, event, or situation, often one of public or personal concern

example.en: The whole affair was handled badly.
example.zh: 整件事处理得很糟糕。

senses.en: a secret romantic or sexual relationship, often with someone other than one's partner

example.en: He admitted to having an affair with a coworker.
example.zh: 他承认与一名同事有婚外情。

senses.en: an event or occasion, especially a social one

example.en: The awards ceremony was a glittering affair.
example.zh: 颁奖典礼是一场光彩夺目的盛会。

senses.en: to tell someone that you will hurt or punish them

example.en: He threatened to call the police.
example.zh: 他威胁说要报警。

senses.en: to be likely to harm or damage someone or something

example.en: Rising seas threaten coastal towns.
example.zh: 海平面上升威胁沿海城镇。

senses.en: to seem likely to happen or cause something bad
senses.zh: 预示（坏事）可能发生；有…的危险

example.en: Dark clouds threatened rain.
example.zh: 乌云预示着要下雨。

senses.en: to plant seeds in the ground

example.en: Farmers sow wheat in the autumn.
example.zh: 农民在秋季播种小麦。

senses.en: to spread or introduce something such as doubt or trouble

example.en: His comments sowed doubt among the team members.
example.zh: 他的言论在团队成员中播下了怀疑的种子。

senses.en: an adult female pig

example.en: The sow gave birth to eight piglets.
example.zh: 这头母猪产下了八只小猪。

senses.en: a printed sheet of information given to people at a talk or class

example.en: The teacher gave us a handout with the key points of the lecture.
example.zh: 老师发给我们一份包含讲座要点的讲义。

senses.en: food, money, or goods given free to someone in need

example.en: The charity provides handouts to families affected by the flood.
example.zh: 该慈善机构向受洪水影响的家庭提供救济品。

senses.en: cooked in hot oil or fat

example.en: We ordered fried rice and spring rolls for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐点了炒饭和春卷。

senses.en: a surname, borne by people such as the American writer James Baldwin

example.en: James Baldwin was a famous American writer and civil rights activist.
example.zh: 詹姆斯·鲍德温是著名的美国作家和民权活动家。

senses.en: glasses with dark lenses that protect your eyes from bright sunlight

example.en: She put on her sunglasses before driving.
example.zh: 她开车前戴上了太阳镜。

senses.en: a road junction where traffic moves in a circle around a central island

example.en: At the roundabout, take the second exit to reach the station.
example.zh: 在环岛处走第二个出口就能到火车站。

senses.en: a rotating playground or amusement ride with seats, chiefly British usage
senses.zh: （游乐场的）旋转转盘；旋转木马类游乐设施（英式）

example.en: The children took turns riding on the roundabout at the park.
example.zh: 孩子们轮流在公园的转盘上玩。

senses.en: not saying or doing something directly; indirect

example.en: She gave a roundabout answer instead of saying yes or no.
example.zh: 她给了一个拐弯抹角的回答，没有直接说是或不是。

senses.en: toward or in a higher place or position

example.en: She stood up to answer the question.
example.zh: 她站起来回答问题。

senses.en: along or toward the higher part of something

example.en: They walked up the hill to see the view.
example.zh: 他们走上山去看风景。

senses.en: out of bed and awake

example.en: I was still up at midnight working on my project.
example.zh: 午夜时我还没睡，在忙我的项目。

senses.en: to increase or raise something

example.en: The company upped its offer to attract more buyers.
example.zh: 公司提高了报价以吸引更多买家。

senses.en: having little or no flavor

example.en: The soup was bland and tasteless.
example.zh: 这汤寡淡无味。

senses.en: offensive or showing poor judgment about what is appropriate

example.en: He told a tasteless joke at the funeral.
example.zh: 他在葬礼上讲了个不得体的笑话。

senses.en: to deliberately ignore or treat someone coldly

example.en: She snubbed him by walking past without a greeting.
example.zh: 她走过时连招呼都不打，冷落了他。

senses.en: an act of deliberately ignoring or insulting someone

example.en: Not inviting her to the party was a real snub.
example.zh: 不邀请她参加聚会是一种明显的冷落。

senses.en: fairly large in size or amount

example.en: He inherited a sizeable fortune from his aunt.
example.zh: 他从姑妈那里继承了一笔可观的财产。

senses.en: a low-ranking noncommissioned officer in the army or marines

example.en: He was promoted to corporal after two years of service.
example.zh: 服役两年后他被提升为下士。

senses.en: relating to the body rather than the mind or spirit

example.en: The soldier received corporal punishment in the past.
example.zh: 过去士兵会遭受体罚。

senses.en: to move a train or vehicle onto a different track

example.en: The wagons were shunted onto a side track.
example.zh: 货车被转到侧线上。

senses.en: to move someone or something aside or to a less important position

example.en: He was shunted to a minor role after the reorganization.
example.zh: 改组后他被调到一个次要岗位。

senses.en: a passage that diverts a bodily fluid such as blood

example.en: The surgeon placed a shunt to drain excess fluid.
example.zh: 医生放置了一根分流管以排出多余积液。

senses.en: at any time; whenever

example.en: You can call me anytime if you need help.
example.zh: 如果需要帮助，你可以随时打电话给我。

senses.en: pigs, especially as farm animals

example.en: The farm raised swine for meat.
example.zh: 这家农场养猪以供食用。

senses.en: an unpleasant, contemptible person

example.en: He called his dishonest business partner a swine.
example.zh: 他骂不诚实的生意伙伴是个卑鄙的家伙。

senses.en: certain to fail or come to a bad end
senses.zh: 注定失败的；注定灭亡的

example.en: The expedition seemed doomed from the start.
example.zh: 这次探险从一开始就注定要失败。

senses.en: an official announcement or report, especially one issued after a meeting

example.en: The two governments issued a joint communique.
example.zh: 两国政府发表了一份联合公报。

senses.en: pretending to be shy or modest, often in a playful way; evasive
senses.zh: 忸怩的；羞怯的；（故作）含糊其辞的

example.en: He was coy about his future plans.
example.zh: 他对未来的计划含糊其辞。

senses.en: to kill someone by nailing them to a cross

example.en: The Romans crucified many criminals in ancient times.
example.zh: 古罗马人曾把许多罪犯钉死在十字架上。

senses.en: to punish or criticize someone very harshly

example.en: The media crucified the politician after the scandal.
example.zh: 丑闻发生后，媒体对那位政客进行了猛烈抨击。

senses.en: to get pleasure from something

example.en: She enjoys reading before bed.
example.zh: 她喜欢睡前阅读。

senses.en: to have something good, such as health or an advantage

example.en: The region enjoys a mild climate.
example.zh: 这个地区气候温和。

senses.en: loyalty and commitment to a country, leader, group, or belief

example.en: The new citizens pledged allegiance to their country.
example.zh: 新公民宣誓效忠自己的国家。

senses.en: happening at exactly the right or useful time

example.en: Your timely warning saved us a lot of trouble.
example.zh: 你及时的提醒为我们省去了很多麻烦。

senses.en: at the right time; in time

example.en: The package arrived timely, just before the holiday.
example.zh: 包裹及时到达，正好赶在假期前。

senses.en: a person who is walking, especially in a town or city

example.en: Pedestrians should use the crossing to cross the road safely.
example.zh: 行人应使用人行横道安全过马路。

senses.en: dull and ordinary, lacking imagination
senses.zh: 平淡的；乏味的；缺乏想象力的

example.en: The critics called the film pedestrian and predictable.
example.zh: 评论家称这部电影平淡乏味且毫无新意。

senses.en: a person whose job is making and altering clothes

example.en: The tailor adjusted the suit to fit him perfectly.
example.zh: 裁缝把这套西装改得非常合身。

senses.en: to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person

example.en: The course can be tailored to meet students' needs.
example.zh: 这门课程可以根据学生的需求进行定制。

senses.en: a structure built by birds or other animals to lay eggs or raise their young

example.en: The bird built a nest in the tree.
example.zh: 鸟在树上筑了个巢。

senses.en: a cozy or comfortable place to live

example.en: They made a cozy nest for themselves in the countryside.
example.zh: 他们在乡下给自己安了一个温馨的小窝。

senses.en: to build or use a nest

example.en: These birds nest on the cliff every spring.
example.zh: 这些鸟每年春天在悬崖上筑巢。

senses.en: to fit one thing inside another in a series

example.en: The bowls nest inside each other for easy storage.
example.zh: 这些碗可以互相套叠，方便收纳。

senses.en: a poor small-scale farmer or agricultural laborer, especially in the past or in developing countries

example.en: Most of the population were peasants who worked the land.
example.zh: 当时大多数人口都是耕种土地的农民。

senses.en: a small piece broken off something

example.en: She found a fragment of glass on the floor.
example.zh: 她在地板上发现了一块玻璃碎片。

senses.en: a small incomplete part of something such as a text or sentence

example.en: Only fragments of the ancient manuscript survive.
example.zh: 这部古代手稿只有一些残片留存下来。

senses.en: to break, or to break something, into small pieces

example.en: The plate fragmented when it hit the ground.
example.zh: 盘子掉在地上摔碎了。

senses.en: continuing to exist or happen for a long time

example.en: The persistent rain flooded the streets.
example.zh: 连绵不断的雨水淹没了街道。

senses.en: refusing to give up despite difficulties

example.en: She was persistent and finally got the job.
example.zh: 她坚持不懈，最终得到了那份工作。

senses.en: involving risk or danger

example.en: Chemical waste must be stored in hazardous material containers.
example.zh: 化学废料必须存放在危险品容器中。

senses.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another

example.en: The teacher was absent, so we had a substitute.
example.zh: 老师不在，所以我们有一位代课老师。

senses.en: to use or act in place of someone or something else

example.en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
example.zh: 在这个食谱里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

senses.en: a player who replaces another in a sports team

example.en: He came on as a substitute in the second half.
example.zh: 他在下半场作为替补上场。

senses.en: in a way that is not bright or clear

example.en: The room was dimly lit by a single candle.
example.zh: 房间被一支蜡烛照得昏暗。

senses.en: a person of lower rank, often used dismissively

example.en: The boss sent one of his underlings to deliver the message.
example.zh: 老板派了一个下属去送口信。

senses.en: relating to a son or daughter; showing respect expected of children

example.en: Caring for elderly parents is seen as a filial duty.
example.zh: 照顾年迈的父母被视为子女应尽的责任。

senses.en: stubborn and determined to do things your own way

example.en: Her headstrong attitude often got her into arguments.
example.zh: 她固执的态度常常让她与人争执。

senses.en: the country where you were born

example.en: She returned to her motherland after twenty years abroad.
example.zh: 在国外二十年之后，她回到了祖国。

senses.en: the condition of being unable to sleep

example.en: Stress and too much caffeine can cause insomnia.
example.zh: 压力和过多的咖啡因会导致失眠。

senses.en: covered with or having thorns

example.en: The rose bush is thorny, so handle it carefully.
example.zh: 这丛玫瑰带刺，所以要小心拿放。

senses.en: difficult and complicated to deal with

example.en: Immigration is a thorny issue in many countries.
example.zh: 移民问题在许多国家都是个棘手的问题。

senses.en: a greenish-blue semi-precious stone used in jewelry

example.en: She wore a silver ring set with turquoise.
example.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有绿松石的银戒指。

senses.en: a light greenish-blue color

example.en: The sea was a brilliant turquoise in the morning light.
example.zh: 晨光下海水呈现出明亮的绿松石色。

senses.en: happening at the same time as something else

example.en: Rapid growth often has concomitant risks.
example.zh: 快速增长常常伴随风险。

senses.en: something that happens or exists together with something else

example.en: Poverty is often a concomitant of unemployment.
example.zh: 贫困常常是失业的伴随物。

senses.en: letting liquid or gas escape through a hole or crack

example.en: The roof is leaky and drips when it rains.
example.zh: 屋顶有裂缝，下雨时会渗水。

senses.en: letting secret information escape

example.en: The agency suffered from leaky confidential files.
example.zh: 该机构因机密文件泄密而受影响。

senses.en: drawings, photos, or images

example.en: The children drew pictures of their families.
example.zh: 孩子们画了自己家人的图画。

senses.en: movies (chiefly British, in phrases like 'go to the pictures')

example.en: They went to the pictures on Saturday night.
example.zh: 他们周六晚上去看了电影。

senses.en: to imagine something or show it in a picture

example.en: She pictured herself living in the countryside.
example.zh: 她想象自己住在乡下。

senses.en: items kept as reminders of a place or event

example.en: They bought souvenirs during their trip to Paris.
example.zh: 他们在巴黎旅行时买了纪念品。

senses.en: having very strict views about what is proper behavior
senses.zh: （行为、道德上）严谨刻板的；守旧的

example.en: Her straitlaced aunt disapproved of the loud party.
example.zh: 她那位刻板的姑妈对喧闹的聚会很不以为然。

senses.en: near that place

example.en: The village is somewhere thereabout.
example.zh: 那个村子就在那一带附近。

senses.en: near that time or amount
senses.zh: 大约那时；接近那个数目

example.en: The repairs will cost 500 dollars or thereabout.
example.zh: 修理费大约是五百美元左右。
